name: expectedDataTypes
displayName: Key types of scientific data anticipated and the repository where each will be managed and shared (NIH 2026 DMS Plan, Element 6)

name: expectedDataType
displayName: Type of scientific data, including species and modality if known
blockURI: e.g. human genomic data; rat fMRI data

name: plannedRepository
displayName: Established repository (or an example) where this data type may be deposited

name: plannedRepositoryURL
displayName: URL of the repository (re3data entry preferred)

name: nihDataSharing
displayName: Assertions matching the NIH 2026 DMS Plan format (NOT-OD-26-046). If any answer is No, explain in Sharing Restrictions or Ethical Restrictions (Element 4)

name: maximumAppropriateSharing
displayName: Will there be maximum appropriate sharing of scientific data underlying peer-reviewed publications and other findings? (Element 1)

name: sharingByPublication
displayName: Will data underlying publications be shared by publication time, or for other findings by end of the period of performance? (Element 2)

name: retentionPerPolicies
displayName: Will shared data be available at least as long as required by repository and/or journal policies? (Element 3)

name: participantProtections
displayName: If human participant data will be shared, will privacy, rights and confidentiality be protected per NOT-OD-22-213, including access controls where needed? (Element 5)

name: gdsRepositorySharing
displayName: For studies under the NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy: will all large-scale human genomic data be shared in an NIH-designated repository on the accelerated timelines? (Element 7a)

name: gdsInstitutionalCertification
displayName: Do you anticipate meeting the Institutional Certification expectations of the GDS Policy (NOT-OD-14-124, IV.C.5)? (Element 7b)

name: ethicsApprovalURL
displayName: Link to the ethics approval or ethics report documentation (exported as maDMP ethical_issues_report)

name: consentProcedure
displayName: Description of participant consent procedures, including whether consent language permits data sharing

name: broadConsentForSharing
displayName: Does the consent obtained permit broad sharing/reuse of the data?

name: humanSubjectsResearch
displayName: Does the study involve human subjects?

name: ethicalRestrictions
displayName: Ethical factors limiting data sharing or reuse (NIH Element 4; aim for 300 words max together with Sharing Restrictions)

name: personalDataIncluded
displayName: Does the dataset contain personal data?

name: sensitiveData
displayName: Does the dataset contain sensitive data?

name: specialCategoryData
displayName: Does the dataset contain special category personal data (GDPR Art. 9)?

name: legalBasisForProcessing
displayName: Legal basis for processing personal data (GDPR Art. 6)

name: anonymizationMethod
displayName: Description of anonymization or pseudonymization applied before sharing

name: dataController
blockURI: Organization name (add ROR URI if available)

name: dataProcessor
blockURI: Organization name (add ROR URI if available)

name: privacyRiskAssessment
displayName: Description of privacy risks and mitigations

name: dataAccessLevel
displayName: Access level for the dataset (maDMP data_access). For embargoes use the Embargo fields below

name: accessRequestProcedure
displayName: Procedure for requesting access to restricted data

name: embargoEndDate
displayName: Date embargo expires. Required when Embargo Applied = Yes; exported as maDMP license start_date

name: licenseURL
displayName: URI of the license governing dataset use

name: reuseConditions
displayName: Conditions for reuse not expressed in the license

name: sharingRestrictions
displayName: Legal or technical factors limiting sharing (NIH Element 4; aim for 300 words max together with Ethical Restrictions)

name: accessContactName
displayName: Name of the contact person for access requests

name: availableUntil
displayName: Date until which the data will remain available (maDMP available_until)

name: storageInfrastructure
displayName: Description of storage environment during and after the project

name: repositoryCertification
displayName: Certification status of the preservation repository (maDMP certified_with)

name: geographicBackupLocation
displayName: Country where backup storage is located

name: metadataStandard
displayName: Metadata standard used. Give name or URL; see the RDA Metadata Standards Catalog

name: persistentIdentifierScheme
displayName: PID scheme used for the data (maDMP pid_system)

name: documentationURL
displayName: Link to data documentation (codebook, README, protocol)

name: interoperabilityStandards
displayName: File or exchange standards beyond metadata schemas (e.g. HL7 FHIR, NetCDF). Use Metadata Standard for metadata schemas

name: controlledVocabularyUsed
displayName: Vocabulary or ontology used in the data or metadata

name: toolsAndSoftware
displayName: Equipment, tools, software or code needed to access and use the data (maDMP technical_resource)

name: relatedResources
displayName: Resources related to this DMP or dataset (publications, protocols, other datasets)

name: relatedResourceIdentifier
displayName: Persistent identifier or URL of the related resource

name: relatedResourceRelationType
displayName: Relation of this dataset/DMP to the resource (DataCite relationType)

name: dmpIdentifier
displayName: Persistent identifier of the DMP (maDMP dmp_id)

name: dmpLastUpdated
displayName: Date DMP was last updated (maDMP modified)

name: dmpVisibility
displayName: Is the DMP public or private? (administrative; excluded from standard exports)

name: dataSteward
displayName: Person responsible for data stewardship (maDMP contributor, role Data Steward)

name: dataStewardORCID
displayName: ORCID iD of the data steward

name: responsibleOrganizationROR
displayName: ROR identifier of the responsible organization

name: cost
displayName: Costs associated with data management, storage, and long-term preservation (maDMP cost)

name: costTitle
displayName: Title of the cost item (maDMP cost.title)

name: costDescription
displayName: Free-text description of the cost (maDMP cost.description)

name: costValue
displayName: Monetary amount of the cost (maDMP cost.value)

name: costCurrencyCode
displayName: ISO 4217 currency code for the cost value (maDMP cost.currency_code)
